# watchpoint_scheduled_report (Resource)

A scheduled report that renders a dashboard (or runs an SGL/audit query) on a recurring schedule and emails the result to a list of recipients.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_scheduled_report" "example" {
  name         = "Weekly Summary"
  dashboard_id = "dash_001"
  schedule     = "Weekly"
  recipients   = ["team@example.com"]
  time_range   = "7d"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable report name; used as the email subject.

### Optional

- `dashboard_id` (String) Dashboard rendered into this report. Leave unset for an SGL/audit CSV export report (see `sgl_query`). Cannot be changed after creation.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Environments (`watchpoint_environment` ids) whose monitors the report includes. Omit for every environment. Unordered.
- `recipients` (Set of String) Email addresses the rendered report is sent to. Unordered.
- `schedule` (String) Delivery cadence: `None`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`. Defaults to `None` (manual-only). Scheduled reports run at 08:00 UTC.
- `sgl_query` (String) When set, the report is an SGL/audit-log CSV export run over `time_range` instead of a dashboard render. Mutually exclusive with `dashboard_id` in practice.
- `time_range` (String) Time window the report covers (e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `7d`, `30d`). Defaults to `24h`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Report ID.
- `last_generated_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent render (RFC 3339), or null if never generated.
- `next_scheduled_at` (String) Timestamp of the next scheduled run (RFC 3339), or null when `schedule` is `None`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_scheduled_report.example rpt_001
```
